sources.title: README.md · coreai-community/YOLOX-CoreAI at main
sources.snippet: Part of the Core AI model zoo (model card). The dense-detector counterpart to RF-DETR-CoreAI: where the DETR family needs no NMS, YOLOX is the classic score = obj · cls + per-class NMS pipeline.
